events.title_original: The Guardian view on Gaza’s misery: don’t let Palestinian deaths mount in this bleak winter | Editorial
events.summary: The formation of a new Israeli government won’t stop the killing, but sustained international pressure must be applied  What do you call a ceasefire when the firing has not ceased? The killings in Gaza decreased when the truce was announced last October, but they did not end. Israel’s strike on Thursday morning on  one of the few remaining functioning hospitals , which killed six people and wounded 28 more, was the first on a healthcare facility since then. But it was not an anomaly. About four Palestinians a day have died on average since the ceasefire was declared.  （原文待翻译）
